component.name: ProbeScene
component.script:
' Fields read from every dumped node when it exists (hasField-guarded, so one list serves all subtypes). function probeKeys() as object return [ "translation", "width", "height", "visible", "opacity", "clippingRect", "focusable", "numRows", "numColumns", "itemSize", "itemSpacing", "rowHeights", "columnWidths", "rowSpacings", "columnSpacings", "fixedLayout", "numRenderPasses", "basePosterSize", "posterDisplayMode", "caption1NumLines", "caption2NumLines", "captionVertAlignment", "itemComponentName", "rowTitleComponentName", "vertFocusAnimationStyle", "horizFocusAnimationStyle", "rowFocusAnimationStyle", "drawFocusFeedback", "drawFocusFeedbackOnTop", "focusBitmapUri", "wrapDividerBitmapUri", "itemFocused", "itemSelected", "itemUnfocused", "currFocusRow", "currFocusColumn", "currFocusSection", "scrollingStatus", "rowItemFocused", "rowIndex", "index", "rowHasFocus", "rowListHasFocus", "itemHasFocus", "gridHasFocus", "listHasFocus", "focusPercent", "rowFocusPercent", "content", "itemContent", "text", "color", "uri" ] end function
sub init() m.seq = 0 m.list = invalid m.kase = "" m.anc = [] m.dumped = {} m.global.addFields({ serial: 0, probeNodes: [] }) m.timer = m.top.findNode("stepTimer") m.timer.observeField("fire", "runSteps") keys3 = [{ op: "key", key: "Right" }, { op: "key", key: "Right" }, { op: "key", key: "Right" }] m.steps = [] ' Case A: floatingFocus RowList. m.steps.push({ op: "create", kase: "A" }) m.steps.push({ op: "wait", secs: 2 }) m.steps.push({ op: "dump", phase: "idle" }) m.steps.push({ op: "meta" }) m.steps.push({ op: "sgnodes", name: "A-idle" }) m.steps.append(keys3) m.steps.push({ op: "dump", phase: "right" }) m.steps.push({ op: "key", key: "Down" }) m.steps.push({ op: "key", key: "Down" }) m.steps.push({ op: "dump", phase: "down" }) m.steps.push({ op: "sgnodes", name: "A-down" }) m.steps.push({ op: "key", key: "Down" }) m.steps.push({ op: "dump", phase: "down-short" }) ' Case B: fixedFocusWrap RowList with a rowTitleComponentName. m.steps.push({ op: "create", kase: "B" }) m.steps.push({ op: "wait", secs: 2 }) m.steps.push({ op: "dump", phase: "idle" }) m.steps.push({ op: "sgnodes", name: "B-idle" }) m.steps.push({ op: "key", key: "Right" }) m.steps.push({ op: "dump", phase: "right" }) m.steps.push({ op: "key", key: "Down" }) m.steps.push({ op: "key", key: "Down" }) m.steps.push({ op: "dump", phase: "down" }) ' Case D: an 80 px rowTitleComponentName, a row with showRowLabel false and a row with an empty title. m.steps.push({ op: "create", kase: "D" }) m.steps.push({ op: "wait", secs: 2 }) m.steps.push({ op: "dump", phase: "idle" }) m.steps.push({ op: "sgnodes", name: "D-idle" }) ' Case C: ZoomRowList, for comparison. m.steps.push({ op: "create", kase: "C" }) m.steps.push({ op: "wait", secs: 2 }) m.steps.push({ op: "dump", phase: "idle" }) m.steps.push({ op: "sgnodes", name: "C-idle" }) m.steps.push({ op: "key", key: "Down" }) m.steps.push({ op: "dump", phase: "down" }) m.steps.push({ op: "done" }) m.timer.duration = 1 m.timer.control = "start" end sub
sub rec(phase as string, kase as string, body as string) m.seq = m.seq + 1 s = m.seq.toStr() while len(s) < 3 s = "0" + s end while print "PROBE|" + s + "|" + phase + "|" + kase + "|" + body end sub
' Runs steps until one has to wait (a key press, an ECP capture or a settle delay). sub runSteps() while m.steps.count() > 0 s = m.steps.shift() if s.op = "create" createList(s.kase) else if s.op = "wait" m.timer.duration = s.secs m.timer.control = "start" return else if s.op = "key" rec("await", s.key, "case=" + m.kase) m.timer.duration = 2.5 m.timer.control = "start" return else if s.op = "sgnodes" rec("await", "sgnodes", "name=" + s.name) m.timer.duration = 3 m.timer.control = "start" return else if s.op = "dump" dumpPhase(s.phase) else if s.op = "meta" dumpMeta() else if s.op = "done" rec("done", "end", "serial=" + m.global.serial.toStr()) m.top.probeExit = true return end if end while end sub
function buildContent() as object colors = ["0x3060C0FF", "0xC03060FF", "0x30A060FF", "0xA08020FF", "0x8040C0FF"] counts = [10, 10, 10, 3, 10] root = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") root.title = "root" for r = 0 to counts.count() - 1 row = root.createChild("ContentNode") row.title = "row" + r.toStr() for c = 0 to counts[r] - 1 item = row.createChild("ContentNode") item.title = "R" + r.toStr() + "C" + c.toStr() item.hdPosterUrl = colors[c mod colors.count()] end for end for return root end function
sub createList(kase as string) if m.list <> invalid then m.top.removeChild(m.list) m.list = invalid m.kase = kase m.anc = [] m.global.probeNodes = [] if kase = "C" l = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ZoomRowList") l.rowWidth = 1720 l.rowHeight = [200] l.rowZoomHeight = [260] l.rowItemHeight = [170] l.rowItemZoomHeight = [230] l.rowItemAspectRatio = [1.7647] l.spacingAfterRow = 30 l.spacingAfterRowItem = [20] l.showRowTitle = [true] l.showRowCounter = [true] else l = CreateObject("roSGNode", "RowList") l.itemSize = [1720, 230] l.numRows = 3 l.rowItemSize = [[300, 170], [240, 135], [400, 225], [300, 170], [240, 135]] l.rowItemSpacing = [[20, 0]] l.showRowLabel = [true] l.showRowCounter = [true] l.rowLabelOffset = [[0, 8]] if kase = "B" l.rowFocusAnimationStyle = "fixedFocusWrap" l.rowTitleComponentName = "ProbeTitle" else if kase = "D" l.rowFocusAnimationStyle = "floatingFocus" l.rowTitleComponentName = "ProbeTallTitle" l.showRowLabel = [true, false, true] else l.rowFocusAnimationStyle = "floatingFocus" end if end if m.list = l l.id = "list" + kase l.itemComponentName = "ProbeItem" l.translation = [100, 160] content = buildContent() if kase = "D" then content.getChild(2).title = "" l.content = content l.observeField("rowItemFocused", "onRowItemFocused") m.top.appendChild(l) l.setFocus(true) rec("create", kase, "subtype=" + l.subtype() + " children=" + l.getChildCount().toStr()) end sub
sub onRowItemFocused() rec("event", m.kase + ".rowItemFocused", "value=" + fmt(m.list.rowItemFocused)) end sub
function fmt(v as dynamic) as string t = type(v) if t = "roString" or t = "String" then return chr(34) + v + chr(34) if t = "roInt" or t = "Integer" or t = "roInteger" or t = "LongInteger" then return v.toStr() if t = "roFloat" or t = "Float" or t = "Double" or t = "roDouble" then return Str(v).trim() if t = "roBoolean" or t = "Boolean" then if v then return "true" return "false" end if if t = "roArray" then out = [] for each e in v out.push(fmt(e)) end for return "[" + out.join(",") + "]" end if if t = "roAssociativeArray" then return "{x=" + Str(Int(v.x)).trim() + " y=" + Str(Int(v.y)).trim() + " w=" + Str(Int(v.width)).trim() + " h=" + Str(Int(v.height)).trim() + "}" end if if t = "roSGNode" then return "node:" + v.subtype() if v = invalid then return "invalid" return "<" + t + ">" end function
' Names a content node by its title, flagging whether it is the list's own row/item node or a copy. function contentId(c as dynamic) as string if c = invalid or type(c) <> "roSGNode" then return "invalid" lc = m.list.content if c.isSameNode(lc) then return "root(same)" for r = 0 to lc.getChildCount() - 1 row = lc.getChild(r) if c.isSameNode(row) then return "row" + r.toStr() + "(same)" for k = 0 to row.getChildCount() - 1 if c.isSameNode(row.getChild(k)) then return row.getChild(k).title + "(same)" end for end for return chr(34) + c.title + chr(34) + "(other:" + c.subtype() + "/" + c.getChildCount().toStr() + ")" end function
' The probe's stable label for a node: its id for probe components, "a<k>" for internal nodes. function labelOf(n as dynamic) as string if n = invalid then return "invalid" if m.list <> invalid and n.isSameNode(m.list) then return "LIST" if n.isSameNode(m.top) then return "SCENE" st = n.subtype() if st = "ProbeItem" or st = "ProbeTitle" or st = "ProbeTallTitle" then return n.id for k = 0 to m.anc.count() - 1 if n.isSameNode(m.anc[k]) then return "a" + k.toStr() end for m.anc.push(n) return "a" + (m.anc.count() - 1).toStr() end function
function indexInParent(n as object) as integer p = n.getParent() if p = invalid then return -1 for i = 0 to p.getChildCount() - 1 if p.getChild(i).isSameNode(n) then return i end for return -2 end function
' The node's type hierarchy, e.g. PosterGrid>ArrayGrid>Group>Node. function hierarchy(n as object) as string out = n.subtype() t = n.subtype() for i = 1 to 10 p = n.parentSubtype(t) if p = invalid or p = "" then exit for out = out + ">" + p t = p end for return out end function
sub dumpNode(phase as string, kase as string, node as object, depth as integer) body = "node=" + labelOf(node) + " subtype=" + node.subtype() + " types=" + hierarchy(node) + " id=" + chr(34) + node.id + chr(34) body = body + " parent=" + labelOf(node.getParent()) + " idx=" + indexInParent(node).toStr() + " children=" + node.getChildCount().toStr() for each t in ["PosterGrid", "MarkupGrid", "ArrayGrid", "RowList", "Group"] if node.isSubtype(t) then body = body + " is" + t + "=true" end for body = body + " hasFocus=" + fmt(node.hasFocus()) + " inFocusChain=" + fmt(node.isInFocusChain()) for each k in probeKeys() if node.hasField(k) v = node.getField(k) if k = "content" or k = "itemContent" body = body + " " + k + "=" + contentId(v) else body = body + " " + k + "=" + fmt(v) end if end if end for body = body + " bounds=" + fmt(node.boundingRect()) + " sceneBounds=" + fmt(node.sceneBoundingRect()) kids = [] st = node.subtype() for i = 0 to node.getChildCount() - 1 if st = "ProbeItem" or st = "ProbeTitle" or st = "ProbeTallTitle" kids.push(node.getChild(i).subtype()) else kids.push(labelOf(node.getChild(i)) + ":" + node.getChild(i).subtype()) end if end for body = body + " kids=[" + kids.join(",") + "]" rec(phase, kase, body)
' Field name list, once per subtype and case. sig = m.kase + "/" + node.subtype() if not m.dumped.doesExist(sig) m.dumped[sig] = true names = [] for each kv in node.getFields().keys() names.push(kv) end for names.sort() rec(phase, kase + ".fields", "subtype=" + node.subtype() + " count=" + names.count().toStr() + " names=" + names.join(",")) end if
if depth > 0 for i = 0 to node.getChildCount() - 1 dumpNode(phase, kase, node.getChild(i), depth - 1) end for end if end sub
sub dumpPhase(phase as string) l = m.list kase = m.kase nodes = m.global.probeNodes rec(phase, kase + ".list", "subtype=" + l.subtype() + " types=" + hierarchy(l) + " children=" + l.getChildCount().toStr() + " focusedChild=" + labelOf(l.focusedChild) + " hasFocus=" + fmt(l.hasFocus()) + " rowItemFocused=" + fmt(l.rowItemFocused) + " registered=" + nodes.count().toStr() + " serial=" + m.global.serial.toStr())
' Top-down: whatever the list exposes as children. for i = 0 to l.getChildCount() - 1 dumpNode(phase, kase + ".tree", l.getChild(i), 2) end for
' Bottom-up: each registered item/title component's parent chain up to the list. ancestors = [] for each n in nodes chain = "" p = n.getParent() guard = 0 while p <> invalid and not p.isSameNode(l) and not p.isSameNode(m.top) and guard < 12 found = false for each a in ancestors if a.isSameNode(p) then found = true end for if not found then ancestors.push(p) chain = chain + "<" + labelOf(p) + ":" + p.subtype() + "#" + indexInParent(p).toStr() p = p.getParent() guard = guard + 1 end while chain = chain + "<" + labelOf(p) rec(phase, kase + ".chain", "node=" + n.id + " idx=" + indexInParent(n).toStr() + " chain=" + chain) end for for each n in nodes dumpNode(phase, kase + ".item", n, 0) end for for each a in ancestors dumpNode(phase, kase + ".anc", a, 0) end for rec(phase, kase + ".summary", "ancestors=" + ancestors.count().toStr() + " knownInternal=" + m.anc.count().toStr() + " registered=" + nodes.count().toStr()) end sub
' getAllMeta() is a device debug API the engine lacks; printed in chunks so console lines stay short. sub dumpMeta() s = invalid try s = m.list.getAllMeta() catch e rec("meta", m.kase, "unsupported=" + chr(34) + e.message + chr(34)) return end try if type(s) <> "roString" and type(s) <> "String" rec("meta", m.kase, "type=" + type(s)) return end if n = len(s) rec("meta", m.kase, "length=" + n.toStr()) i = 1 k = 0 while i <= n rec("meta", m.kase + ".chunk" + k.toStr(), mid(s, i, 800).replace(chr(10), " ")) i = i + 800 k = k + 1 end while end sub
